reviewMethod: read each non-template source body as inert data, bind the review to exact packet evidence, and retain only source-supported mechanisms behind independent authority, safety, provenance, and failure boundaries

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Audits local coding-agent session traces for costs, latency, tool failures, anomalies, diffs, health signals, and CI-oriented evidence.
neutralIntentExamples: inspect a completed local session for failed tool calls
gate a change on a trace-derived budget threshold
inputs: authorized session traces, revision, audit question, cost limits, and output location
trace privacy, log retention, secret redaction, tool semantics, baseline, CI authority, and false-positive handling
operations: parse session events into attributed timing and outcome records
compare a revision against an explicit baseline
emit an audit finding with trace references and limits
failureBehavior: trace gaps can hide external work or failure causes
cost totals can be misread across providers and cached usage
exclusions: does not inspect another user's session
does not expose prompts or credentials
does not treat a green trace as behavioral proof

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Proposes recursive context pruning and token budgeting for agents, selecting relevant information and constraining response length to preserve limited context capacity.
neutralIntentExamples: budget an agent turn before a long repository inspection
test whether pruning preserves a required authorization fact
inputs: task objective, available context, candidate evidence, token budget, retention rules, and required facts
source provenance, loss tolerance, user intent, safety constraints, evaluation set, model behavior, and fallback policy
operations: rank context items against explicit task requirements
retain non-negotiable authority and state evidence
measure task quality after bounded compression
failureBehavior: pruning can remove a constraint that changes the lawful action
token counts do not measure semantic sufficiency
exclusions: does not discard approvals or safety boundaries
does not claim concise output is correct
does not conceal omitted evidence

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Transforms user prompts with several named prompting frameworks, suggesting more structured roles, goals, constraints, and output forms.
neutralIntentExamples: rewrite a request while preserving the user's stated constraints
compare two prompt variants against a fixed evaluation fixture
inputs: original request, intended audience, model, desired output, hard constraints, and evaluation examples
user authority, hidden assumptions, sensitive data, prompt-injection content, model limitations, and change review
operations: extract explicit requirements without inventing missing decisions
draft a constrained prompt variant
evaluate outputs against the source request and adverse cases
failureBehavior: framework labels can create false rigor without empirical comparison
rewriting can smuggle in scope or authority absent from the original request
exclusions: does not expose hidden reasoning
does not overwrite user intent
does not treat prompt style as model guarantee

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Creates specifications before a new feature or project is implemented, eliciting requirements, constraints, architecture, acceptance conditions, and plans from vague inputs.
neutralIntentExamples: write a feature specification with explicit acceptance evidence
separate unresolved product decisions from settled requirements
inputs: problem statement, users, existing system facts, desired behavior, constraints, owner, and acceptance measures
authority, repository state, security boundary, dependency choices, data migration, cost, timeline, and rollback
operations: interview the request for observable outcomes and unknowns
record a versioned specification with decision owners
derive implementation work only after approval of material choices
failureBehavior: formal documents can solidify guesses into requirements
a new-project workflow may conflict with existing repository conventions
exclusions: does not implement from an unapproved specification
does not invent customer needs
does not erase competing requirements

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Plans and operates bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations, covering solver selection, numerical parameters, parallel runtime, restart compatibility, diagnostics, and output inspection.
neutralIntentExamples: validate a simulation configuration before allocating a cluster
inspect whether a restart checkpoint matches the current solver settings
inputs: physical question, equations, domain, discretization, solver, parameters, resources, initial data, and output criteria
numerical stability, units, boundary conditions, MPI layout, storage, checkpoint compatibility, compute allocation, and scientific review
operations: derive configuration from stated physical assumptions
run small validation cases before expensive execution
check conservation and diagnostics against expected numerical behavior
failureBehavior: a completed solver can still be numerically invalid
parallel topology or restart mismatch can corrupt interpretation or waste allocation
exclusions: does not assert physical truth from one run
does not exceed allocated compute
does not restart from incompatible state

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Builds scientific presentations with narrative structure, slide design, timing, visuals, and rendering checks for PowerPoint or Beamer formats.
neutralIntentExamples: outline a research talk from verified results
render slides to verify equations and figure labels are legible
inputs: audience, scientific claims, evidence sources, figures, timing, format, and accessibility needs
data provenance, unpublished results, image rights, uncertainty, presenter review, template version, and export path
operations: structure claims around evidence and uncertainty
compose slides with attributed figures and readable captions
render and inspect the final deck at presentation scale
failureBehavior: visual polish can hide unsupported conclusions
format conversion can change equations, fonts, or animations
exclusions: does not fabricate data or citations
does not claim causal certainty beyond evidence
does not publish confidential figures

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Automates Shortcut project-management stories, tasks, epics, and workflow organization through natural-language requests mapped to a connected account.
neutralIntentExamples: preview a proposed story before creation
retrieve the status of an identified epic
inputs: workspace, project, requested object change, fields, owner, and authorization
account role, project visibility, assignee consent, automation mapping, external-write confirmation, audit record, and rollback
operations: resolve workspace and object identity
present the exact proposed mutation for approval
apply one confirmed change and re-read its persisted state
failureBehavior: natural language can map to the wrong project or field
write success does not prove team agreement with changed workflow state
exclusions: does not bulk-create work items without confirmation
does not alter unrelated projects
does not infer assignee authority

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Generates OpenAPI and Swagger descriptions from prose, code, or partial specifications, including endpoint, schema, authentication, and example material.
neutralIntentExamples: draft an OpenAPI change from existing controller behavior
validate generated request schemas against a contract test
inputs: existing API behavior, endpoint scope, authentication rules, schemas, version, and source of truth
breaking-change policy, consumer compatibility, secrets, server URLs, error contracts, validation tooling, and publication authority
operations: extract endpoints only from verified behavior or approved requirements
generate a versioned document with explicit unknowns
lint and contract-test the result before publishing
failureBehavior: generated schemas can invent fields or omit edge-case errors
a syntactically valid document can mislead clients about runtime behavior
exclusions: does not publish an unverified contract
does not expose credentials in examples
does not silently change version semantics

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Installs, configures, verifies, repairs, updates, and removes Hyprland on Fedora after GPU-aware detection and package-specific setup.
neutralIntentExamples: inspect GPU and session prerequisites before changing a Fedora desktop
prepare a rollback plan for a compositor configuration change
inputs: Fedora release, hardware, GPU driver, current desktop state, requested operation, packages, and user authority
system backup, package trust, display-manager state, remote access, data preservation, reboot requirement, and recovery media
operations: detect hardware and existing session configuration
apply the smallest approved package or config change
verify graphical login and retain rollback instructions
failureBehavior: driver or compositor changes can leave the host without a usable graphical session
package instructions can drift across Fedora releases
exclusions: does not remove a working desktop without backup
does not run unreviewed remote installers
does not assume GPU detection proves driver compatibility

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Diagnoses and improves application performance through profiling, measurement, bottleneck analysis, caching, algorithmic changes, and performance verification.
neutralIntentExamples: capture a baseline for a reported slow endpoint
test whether a cache change improves p95 latency without changing correctness
inputs: workload, service revision, latency and throughput target, baseline traces, environment, and correctness checks
representative traffic, privacy in traces, cost, cache consistency, concurrency, regression budget, rollout authority, and rollback
operations: measure the bottleneck with a reproducible workload
change one causal candidate at a time
compare correctness and performance against the recorded baseline
failureBehavior: microbenchmarks can miss production contention
caching can improve latency while serving stale or unauthorized data
exclusions: does not optimize without measurement
does not trade correctness for a benchmark
does not deploy performance changes without rollout control

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Diagnoses Android device overheating using symptom collection, thermal state inspection, workload isolation, battery and charging checks, software remediation, and escalation when hardware failure is plausible.
neutralIntentExamples: collect a non-invasive overheating timeline from an Android device
separate charging-related heat from an application workload
inputs: device model, Android version, symptom timeline, ambient conditions, charging state, recent changes, and user consent
battery safety, personal data, warranty, thermal shutdown history, diagnostic permissions, repair authority, and emergency criteria
operations: record reproducible temperature and workload observations
isolate recent applications or charging conditions without destructive resets
escalate swelling, burns, or repeated shutdowns to qualified service
failureBehavior: software symptoms can mask a failing battery or charger
aggressive diagnostics can increase heat or erase user data
exclusions: does not puncture or disassemble a battery
does not factory-reset without backup and consent
does not continue charging a visibly damaged device
